Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ قَصُرَتِ الْاَلْسُنُ عَنْ بُلُوغِ ثَنَائِكَ
Translation: My God, tongues fall short of reaching Your praise
As befits Your Majesty

Arabic text: وَعَجَزَتِ الْعُقُولُ عَنْ إِدْرَاكِ كُنْهِ جَمَالِكَ
Translation: And minds are incapable of comprehending the essence of Your Beauty

Arabic text: وَانْحَسَرَتِ الْاَبْصَارُ دُوْنَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى سُبُحَاتِ وَجْهِكَ
Translation: And eyes are unable to gaze at the splendor of Your Face

Arabic text: وَلَمْ تَجْعَلْ لِلْخَلْقِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى مَعْرِفَتِكَ
Translation: And You have not made for creation a path to Your knowledge
Except through the inability to truly know You

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ فَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ تَرَسَّخَتْ أَشْجَارُ الشَّوْقِ
Translation: My God, make us among those in whose hearts
The trees of longing for You are firmly rooted
And the passion of Your love has seized their hearts
So they take refuge in the nests of contemplation
And in the gardens of nearness and unveiling they graze

Arabic text: وَمِنْ حِيَاضِ الْمَحَبَّةِ بِكَأْسِ الْمُلاطَفَةِ يَكْرَعُونَ
Translation: And from the pools of love with the cup of kindness they drink deeply
And to the springs of pure friendship they arrive
The veil has been lifted from their eyes

Arabic text: وَانْجَلَتْ ظُلْمَةُ الرَّيْبِ عَنْ عَقَائِدِهِمْ وَضَمَائِرِهِمْ
Translation: And the darkness of doubt has been removed from their beliefs and consciences

Arabic text: وَانْتَفَتْ مُخَالَجَةُ الشَّكِّ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَرَائِرِهِمْ
Translation: And the intrusion of uncertainty has been eliminated from their hearts and innermost thoughts
And their chests have been expanded through the verification of knowledge

Arabic text: وَعَلَتْ لِسَبْقِ السَّعَادَةِ فِيْ الزَّهَادَةِ هِمَمُهُمْ
Translation: And their aspirations have been elevated through precedence of happiness in detachment
And their drink has become sweet from the spring of good conduct
And their inner secrets have become pleasant in the gathering of intimacy
And they feel secure in the place of fear

Arabic text: وَاطْمَأَنَّتْ بِالرُّجُوعِ إِلَى رَبِّ الْاَرْبَابِ أَنْفُسُهُمْ
Translation: And their souls have found tranquility in returning to the Lord of Lords
And their spirits have attained certainty of success and prosperity
And their eyes have been delighted by gazing at their Beloved

Arabic text: وَاسْتَقَرَّ بِإِدْرَاكِ السُّؤْلِ وَنَيْلِ الْمَأْمُولِ قَرَارُهُمْ
Translation: And they have found stability through achieving their requests and attaining their hopes

Arabic text: وَرَبِحَتْ فِيْ بَيْعِ الدُّنْيَا بِالْآخِرَةِ تِجَارَتُهُمْ
Translation: And their trade has profited in selling this world for the Hereafter

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ مَا أَلَذَّ خَوَاطِرَ الْاِلْهَامِ بِذِكْرِكَ عَلَى الْقُلُوبِ
Translation: My God, how delightful are the thoughts of inspiration with Your remembrance upon the hearts

Arabic text: وَمَا أَحْلَى الْمَسِيرَ إِلَيْكَ بِالْاَوْهَامِ فِيْ مَسَالِكِ الْغُيُوبِ
Translation: And how sweet is the journey to You through contemplation along the paths of the unseen
And how pleasant is the taste of Your love
And how sweet is the drink of Your nearness
So protect us from Your rejection and dismissal
And make us among Your most special knowers
And Your most righteous servants
And Your most truthful followers
And Your most sincere worshippers
O Magnificent, O Majestic
O Generous, O Bestower
By Your mercy and Your favor
O Most Merciful of the merciful ones
